assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE individual high-definition painted 2D fighting-game base sprite for Half-Life Resonance. Input image is an original source-game identity reference, not an edit target. Translate its distinctive silhouette, proportions, exact mechanical construction, colors and materials into crisp detailed 2D game art. Single whole subject, neutral idle base pose, three-quarter side view, facing screen right where meaningful. Keep all extremities inside the canvas with approximately 10 percent empty margin. Genuine transparent alpha background. Soft upper-left light with source-game material colors. No scenery, ground plane, cast shadow, HUD, title, captions, watermark, duplicates, contact sheet or animation sheet. No invented additions or redesigned anatomy. 

Depict the defective Aperture turret from the Portal 2 retail campaign exactly as the attached model image: missing white outer shell panels, exposed dark charcoal oval structural frames with large openings and small rivets; red radial iris in the central frame, square pale plate above the eye, round brown-red speaker below; side mechanisms and blue inner components exposed; three long pointed dark tripod legs and a short dangling black cable. Match this campaign defective model, one subject in a still neutral idle pose with open exposed framework, no firing, flashes or laser, no invented shell or attachments. Keep every leg and frame inside the canvas.
assets.reference_review: Inspected retail model capture of shell-less defective turret: dark perforated oval frames, red radial eye, pale rectangular plate above eye, reddish circular speaker below, exposed blue inner pieces and three dark legs. Campaign defective identity selected; no Oracle or co-op functional variant asserted.
